newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to appeal rap singers' tough prison terms.
newsitem.headline: France to appeal rap singers' tough prison terms.

text.p: (Note: 5th and 9th paragraphs contain material that readers may find offensive)

French Justice Minister Jacques Toubon said on Saturday the government would appeal against jail sentences and a performance ban served on two singers in a French rap band for using lyrics savaging the police.
Toubon, appearing in a televised debate, said he had asked state prosecutors to appeal against a three-month jail term and six-month performing ban on the singers in the popular rap group NTM.
The ruling triggered fierce debate in France over censorship and respect for public officials.

Police unions and some politicians including the far-right National Front have hailed the judgment as a check on unbridled attacks on law enforcement authorities, while others have denounced it as censorship.
NTM stands for "Nique Ta Mere" (Fuck Your Mother).

Singers Bruno Lopez, also known as Kool Shen, and Didier Morville, called Joey Star, have already said they will appeal Thursday's convictions by a Toulon court of attacking public officials through their songs.

The court action was launched by 26 policemen who were on crowd control duty at a concert featuring the band, organised to protest against the election of a National Front candidate as mayor of the Toulon last year.
The court was told the group used the following lyrics during their performance:

"I (sodomise) and piss on the courts. The police are the fascists and the murderers. It's those motherfuckers in blue and the courts who bust our balls all year round...our enemies are the men in blue (the police) and we piss on them."
